blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday received outgoing Spanish Ambassador to the Philippines Miguel Utray in a farewell call at Malacañan Palace. In a press release, the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said Marcos thanked Utray for his contributions to strengthening cooperation between the Philippines and Spain during his four-year tour of duty in the country. Utray, who assumed his post in October 2022, is set to depart Manila on Oct. 14 for his new assignment as Spain’s ambassador to Angola.
